g.text: A correct answer can be lost after a challenge
Illustrative example for teaching; not a measured paper example
“9 is odd, and odd numbers are prime.
The premise does not justify the claim.
An answer change counts as a flip
if the final option is any wrong option.
Good revision requires checking the argument, not just accepting its conclusion.
Who Flips? arXiv:2606.16011v2 | Protocol definition; toy question and argument written for this deck
